name: computer_core_2
title: Computer Core 2 (ALPHA)
author: SirEdvin; original Computer Core by Relik77 and contributors
description: EXPERIMENTAL 0.3.0 ALPHA PLAYTEST - adds a blue, built-in-only event-driven shell computer alongside unchanged original/personal VM computers with Recrafted shell/editors. Blue files are data: no Lua scripts, editors or modules. Both models use existing computer research. No guest world/network APIs. Graphical input/rendering and multiplayer joins remain unverified. Back up saves, prefer a fresh test world and never downgrade a migrated save. Expect bugs and API changes.
